title: A field actor's scripted animation: res/field/actors/animations/<n>.json
description: File n of ARCID_FIELD_ACTOR_ANIMATION (a/2/0/0), which a script plays on an actor by its number (Scrcmd_FieldActorAnimation_ActorAnimationPlay, field_actor_animation.c): a curve (ica_anime.c) that FieldActorAnmProc_Update steps a frame at a time, moving the actor to its translation from where it started and turning it to face down, right, up or left as its rotation's Y is 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees (FieldActorAnmProc_CommitTransform). The game turns each float into fixed point (FX32_CONST). tools/data/field_actor_animation_data.py packs them in order.

values.description: The values each frame has, of scale, rotation and translation in that order (the file's flags)

frames.description: The frames, each with the values that values names

scale.description: The scale on X, Y and Z, which the field actors' animations don't read

rotation.description: The rotation around X, Y and Z, in degrees

translation.description: Where the actor is from where it started, in units
